name: Gong
tagline: Revenue AI that captures and analyzes customer conversations to close deals.
description: Gong is a Revenue AI platform that records and analyzes sales calls, emails, and meetings to surface deal risk, coaching opportunities, and more accurate forecasts. Its Revenue Graph and AI agents automate follow-ups, pipeline updates, and forecast corrections across products like Gong Engage, Forecast, and Enable. It is widely used by enterprise revenue teams.
insight: Raised a $250M Series E in June 2021 at a $7.25B valuation, led by Franklin Templeton.
edge: The category-defining revenue-intelligence incumbent — deepest call-analysis dataset and enterprise-grade forecasting versus newer point tools.

references.title: Gong grabs $250M Series E on $7.25B valuation
